chapters.label: Two minutes left
chapters.text: Munich, 2012, the Champions League final. Bayern lead Chelsea one–nil, two minutes left. Chelsea win their first corner. Juan Mata whips it in... Didier Drogba powers a header in! One-all!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. Drogba sprints to the near post, gets there first, and uses his forehead to power it into the top corner.

chapters.label: Behind the goal
chapters.text: From behind the goal, see how fast it flies. The keeper has no time to move. Chelsea win on penalties!

chapters.label: Attack the near post
chapters.text: Attack the near post! Get there first, jump, and power your header where you aim.
